SHARED-F-2-S27.title: Consent Core Logic and Tier Enforcement
SHARED-F-2-S27.description: Implement core consent workflow logic supporting two-tier HIPAA consent. Enforce tier rules (Tier 1: de-identified storage only, Tier 2: full data allowed with consent) and ensure all downstream services query consent state before persisting data.

SHARED-F-2-S28.title: Consent De-identification and Storage Decision Engine
SHARED-F-2-S28.description: Implement decision engine that determines whether to store raw or de-identified data based on consent tier. Apply HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification rules and integrate with conversation summarization prior to persistence.

SHARED-F-2-S29.title: Consent Framework Tests
SHARED-F-2-S29.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier enforcement, de-identification correctness, storage decisions, and failure cases (missing consent, invalid tier transitions). Ensure coverage aligns with HIPAA handling expectations.
SHARED-F-2-S29.evidence: GAP: No existing consent-specific tests found; must be created following existing backend test patterns

SHARED-F-2-S30.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture and Debug Logger
SHARED-F-2-S30.description: Integrate consent framework with lead capture and debug logging systems to ensure all persisted data respects consent tier. Enforce de-identification for logs when Tier 1 is active and allow full storage only under Tier 2.
